en.text: Health and lifestyle support built around real life

af.text: Gesondheids- en leefstylondersteuning vir die werklike lewe

entries.purpose: Explain the platform at the bounded launch entry without overpromising; participant-facing brand name is always injected through {{platform_name}}.
entries.notes: Owner accepted the current positioning text on 2026-11-02. Participant-facing brand remains unresolved and is injected through {{platform_name}}. Exact development approval still requires the normal scoped content/language evidence.

en.text: {{platform_name}} is a Christian, temperament-guided health and lifestyle platform for adult women. It is designed to help you understand your patterns, build sustainable habits and make practical health choices.

af.text: {{platform_name}} is ’n Christelike, temperamentgerigte gesondheids- en leefstylplatform vir volwasse vroue. Dit is ontwerp om jou te help om jou patrone beter te verstaan, volhoubare gewoontes te bou en praktiese gesondheidskeuses te maak.

entries.purpose: State the relevant launch safety boundary without adding emergency language to P8-05.
entries.notes: Owner accepted the safety boundary and asked that its information limits be explicit. This candidate keeps the distinction between platform guidance and individual professional care, including individual dietetic care, even though dietetic expertise is part of the team. No emergency/urgent-support wording is added because current P8-05 authority does not define that outcome here.

en.text: {{platform_name}} supports general wellness and guided self-management. Our guidance is based on the information you choose to provide and can only be as relevant as the information available to us. It does not replace medical, psychological or individual dietetic care. Where personalised guidance is not appropriate, {{platform_name}} may limit automated guidance and direct you to a safer or more appropriate next step.

af.text: {{platform_name}} ondersteun algemene welstand en begeleide selfbestuur. Ons leiding is gebaseer op die inligting wat jy kies om met ons te deel en kan net so relevant wees soos die inligting wat tot ons beskikking is. Dit vervang nie mediese, sielkundige of individuele dieetkundige sorg nie. Waar persoonlike leiding nie gepas is nie, kan {{platform_name}} outomatiese leiding beperk en jou na ’n veiliger of meer gepaste volgende stap lei.
